featured_reviews.name: Neha Mendon
featured_reviews.review_text:
Masa Bakery has quickly become a standout destination for those who appreciate the intersection of artisanal craft and a cozy, neighborhood vibe. Tucked away on Juhu Tara Road, it offers an escape from the Mumbai bustle with its minimalist, warm aesthetic and the undeniable aroma of fresh yeast and butter.
Masa specializes in small-batch baking, and the quality is evident in the textures of their breads and pastries.
Laminated Pastries: Their croissants are a masterclass in layering—shatteringly crisp on the outside with a soft, airy, honeycomb interior. The Almond Croissant is particularly noteworthy for its generous filling that isn't overly sweet.
The Sourdough: A staple for many regulars, their sourdough loaves have a robust crust and a perfectly developed tang. It serves as an excellent base for their various tartines and toasties.
Artisanal Bites: Beyond the classics, look for their seasonal danishes and savory puffs, which often feature creative flavor combinations like caramelized onion, goat cheese, or local seasonal fruits.
Coffee: They take their brews as seriously as their bakes. The coffee is consistently well-extracted, making it a reliable spot for a flat white or a pour-over to pair with your pastry.
Masa Bakery brings a slice of modern, high-end bakery culture to Juhu. While it sits at a slightly higher price point than your average local bakery, the attention to detail in their fermentation process and the quality of ingredients make it well worth the visit for any dedicated carb-connoisseur. Very quaintly located in Juhu with an Interesting Menu #Masa #Bakery #Juhu

featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Café – So I got hooked to this newly opened joint of Elementaria Café in Juhu. I am regular visitor of the brand in Matunga branch and love their offerings and overall spread of options. I was one of the first customers to this newly open joint and in terms of overall food and drinks quality I relished it.

Luckily we were 4 friends and we tried many things out there as below

•    Vietnamese cake icecream (If I recollect it right) (Rating 3/5) – Thought this would be really interesting given its description but was let down as the cake/pastry was hard even to cut it through spoon. Is it really supposed to be like this I doubt.

•    Hazelnut Red Velvet Tubcake (Rating 5/5) & Intense Chocolate Tubcake (Rating 5/5) – These were lovely little cakes with intense chocolate flavors. The cake around the chocolate liquid was decadent to satisfy with each bite. Loved both.

•    48 Layers Chocolate Cake (Rating 5/5) – This is the best dessert out there IMO! This 48 layer signature cake is so so good that you can actually get it for free if you end up finishing the same in less 10 mins. The entire cake takes about 2 days to make and it weighs roughly 13 pounds.

•    Choco Shake Rating (4/5) – Decent shake offered at their place! Similar to keventers but I think slightly better version imo!

•    Messy Melon icecream (Rating 5/5) – This is another signature item to have at their place. See the picture and you will know why its so sought after item to order. The lovely creation of water melon cut in intricate manner accompanied with delicious melon icecream is a winner! Must order out there.

•    Peri Peri Paneer Hotdog (Rating 4/5) & Chicken Tikka Sandwich (Rating 4/5) – Both offerings were great savory accompaniments with dessert choices they have out there. My personal fav was chicken tikka sandwich which comes with brown bread and generous amount of chicken tikka semi dry gravy. Paneer had unique spiciness but I felt salt somehow lacking in it! Maybe it was my bad day but liked it in general.

•    Marshmellow Hot Chocolate (Rating 5/5) & Hot Mocha with Marshmellow (Rating 5/5)  - Both were WOW! U cant go wrong with these choices usually and this place keeps up with the standards too. Hot chocolate was my personal fav which had the lovely texture of chocolate milk and thick enough to sip in fractions and enjoy till late evenings.

Overall the food and desserts were good, staff even though it was first day were able to manage our orders and others at a same time, the only downside in my opinion of this place is the ambience. It gets extremely uncomfortable to be there inspite of fans at almost each table. They should try adding cooler or something that can make sitting out there pleasant. Hope they can hence for now I rate them 4 for my overall experience.

featured_reviews.name: Jewel Dsz
featured_reviews.review_text:
​We recently visited Poetry Cafe, and the experience was as artistic as the name suggests. I tried their Strawberry Tart, and it was exceptional.
​The Crust: Perfectly buttery and crumbly, providing a great base for the dish.
​The Filling: The strawberry mousse was light, airy, and carried just the right amount of natural sweetness.
​The Garnish: The glazed, fresh strawberries on top added a wonderful brightness and a satisfying texture.
​It is rare to find a place that balances presentation and flavor so well. If you have a sweet tooth, this tart is an absolute must-order. The cafe provides a cozy, thoughtful atmosphere—perfect for a slow afternoon or a creative break. Thanks to Fida and for his quick excellent service 👏
​Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Kaushik Kolhapure
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poetry by Love & Cheesecake in Juhu is a perfect little escape for anyone who enjoys cozy cafés and good desserts. The vibe is calm, aesthetic, and ideal for unwinding whether you’re catching up with friends or just spending some quiet “me time.”

The cheesecakes are definitely the highlight rich, creamy, and absolutely worth it. Their menu also has a good variety of snacks, beverages, and light bites that complement the desserts really well. The coffee pairs nicely, making it a great spot for a relaxed evening.

Service is friendly, and the overall ambience has that soothing, almost poetic charm that the name promises. Slightly on the pricier side, but the quality and experience make it worth it.

A go-to place in Juhu if you’re in the mood for something sweet and peaceful.

featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happened to visit this place when the restaurant that we had a reservation couldn't give us a table. We really enjoyed our visit here. We had a veg club sandwich and a pink sauce pasta both well done. Service was moderately quick for food but faster for the desserts & coffee. We tried their donuts chocolate and lotus Biscoff variants which are both well made and served warm. Their cafe mocha however wasn't upto the mark. The coffee in itself seemed like a dark roast and there was nil chocolate flavour except for the topping of chocolate sauce in the cup. We would probably pass the coffee section next time. But their food and desserts are an absolute hit. The fries served alongside the sandwich were also fresh and seemed homemade and not frozen.
The ambience was good, lighting was bright and the seating was comfortable. There are ample tables available to choose from. Staff were warm, professional and welcoming. We had a fantastic experience at the outlet and are happy to have visited. Not sure if they have a valet for parking though.

featured_reviews.review_text: Food is delicious. Ambience is good. Service is very slow. And they are not Even though the place was not crowded. The kitchen staff seems to be understaffed. featured_reviews.name: Shweta
featured_reviews.review_text:
For a place that is known for cheesecake, I cannot understand why Poetry decided to fill its blueberry “cheesecake” with whipped cream. You know how to make cheesecakes (as evidenced by the apple crumble cheesecake we also ordered); so own it! Don’t stoop to the level of imitators who often pass off the blueberry “whipped cream cake” as an “authentic cheesecake” to the common Mumbaikar.

Next disappointment: the “mandarin” mojito which was actually a mosambi juice with no mandarin or mojito to be tasted.

Finally, a note to your chefs: from an avowed chili lover, more green chilies does not equal better taste, in fact it makes food inedible. Uncle Roger himself would be crying tears of fresh disappointment. We had to find and remove every green chili from the Asian rice bowl, and now we’re no longer sure what is a green chili, or a green onion, or a simple green bean. Don’t fall victim to this unfortunate restaurant trend. We believe in you!

Other than that, good flavours as always, great pesto chicken.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
🍰 Bandra Cakery by Bunty Mahajan – Truffle Desserts Done Exceptionally Well

Tried multiple desserts from Bandra Cakery by Bunty Mahajan, and the experience clearly reflects why this brand has such a strong reputation in Mumbai’s dessert scene.

I sampled the Dutch Truffle, Hazelnut Dutch Truffle, and Strawberry Dutch Truffle desserts. All three were rich, indulgent, and well-balanced, without being overly sweet.

The Dutch Truffle stood out with its deep chocolate flavour and smooth, creamy texture — classic, intense, and very satisfying.
The Hazelnut Dutch Truffle elevated the experience further, adding a nutty richness that paired beautifully with the chocolate, making it my personal favourite.
The Strawberry Dutch Truffle offered a refreshing contrast, with the slight tartness of strawberry cutting through the richness of the truffle base, making it lighter yet indulgent.

Portion sizes are generous, the quality of ingredients is evident, and the desserts feel premium from the first bite to the last. Packaging was neat and secure, ensuring the desserts arrived in excellent condition.

Overall, a solid choice for anyone who enjoys rich chocolate-based desserts with refined flavours.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Anverali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deliciae by Bunty Mahajan: Mango Biscoff Cheesecake = Summer in a Slice*

Deliciae never misses with desserts, but the *Mango Biscoff Cheesecake* is next-level indulgence. If you think mango and Biscoff sounds risky, this will convert you.

*Presentation*: It arrives looking like art. A perfect round slice with that golden mango glaze on top, a generous dusting of Biscoff crumbs, and a caramelized Biscoff biscuit perched on the side. The layers are clean and distinct even before the first bite. You can tell it’s been set with care, not rushed.

*Taste & Texture*: This is where it becomes addictive. The base is a thick, buttery Biscoff crust that holds up without crumbling everywhere. It gives you that warm, spiced caramel note in every forkful. The cheesecake layer is insanely smooth and creamy, with a light tang that cuts through the sweetness. Then comes the mango: real Alphonso pulp, not artificial essence. It’s fresh, tropical, and balances the Biscoff beautifully so nothing feels cloying. The top glaze adds a subtle fruity brightness. Together it’s sweet, spiced, tangy, and lush.

*Overall Experience*: Each bite gives you multiple textures. Crumbly base, silky cheesecake, soft mango layer, and that little crunch from Biscoff crumbs on top. It’s rich but not heavy, and somehow feels both decadent and summery at once. Portion size is generous enough to share, though you won’t want to.

*Vibe at Deliciae*: The patisserie itself matches the dessert. Elegant, pastel, with display counters that make you want everything. Staff are super helpful and package it beautifully if you’re taking away. No soggy cheesecake disasters here.

*Verdict*: Mango + Biscoff sounds like a weird collab that should not work, but Deliciae makes it iconic. This cheesecake is indulgent, balanced, and wildly photogenic. Easily one of the best fusion desserts I have had this season.

*Pro tip*: Pair it with their cold coffee. Thank me later.

Already craving my next slice. If you’re a cheesecake or mango person, skip everything else and get this first.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra

5-Star Review for Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan
Absolutely Divine! The Hazelnut Divine Cake is a Masterpiece ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I ordered the 1kg Hazelnut Divine Cake from Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan as a special surprise for an amazing female trainer at the gym – a heartfelt thank you for all her motivation and hard work.

From the moment it arrived, it was clear this was no ordinary cake. The presentation was stunning: a glossy chocolate mirror glaze that shone beautifully, elegant swirls of rich chocolate rosettes, scattered roasted hazelnuts for that perfect crunch, and even a personalized plaque that made it feel extra thoughtful.

But the real magic happened when we cut into it – layers of moist vanilla sponge intertwined with generous chocolate ganache and crunchy roasted hazelnuts. Every bite was an explosion of decadent chocolate-hazelnut flavor, perfectly balanced, not overly sweet, and incredibly indulgent. It truly lived up to its “Divine” name!

This cake didn’t just taste extraordinary; it made her day truly special. Her smile and excitement said it all – it was the highlight of the gym ! At around ₹2631, it was worth every single rupee for the premium quality, freshness, and joy it brought.
Deliciae By Bunty Mahajan continues to be Mumbai’s best pâtisserie for a reason – flawless execution, timely delivery, and cakes that are as beautiful as they are delicious.

Highly recommend for any celebration or just to make someone’s day unforgettable. Thank you, team – you’ve gained a loyal customer!

featured_reviews.name: Roxanne Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly cannot believe how terrible my experience with Theobroma has been. Their customer service is beyond unacceptable. I placed an order well in advance, gave clear instructions, and expected basic professionalism — but apparently that’s too much for them.

They kept delaying, giving excuse after excuse, and still couldn’t manage to make the simple cake I requested. Every time I followed up, I got vague answers and zero responsibility. And then, as if the incompetence wasn’t enough, they had the nerve to cancel my order at the absolute last minute.

Who does that?

This was for an important occasion, and they left me scrambling with no time to fix their mess. The sheer lack of organisation, accountability, and respect for customers is unbelievable. For a brand that pretends to be “premium,” their behaviour is anything but.

If I could give zero stars — or honestly, negative stars — Theobroma would earn them without a second thought. One star is the absolute minimum this platform allows, and even that feels far too generous for what they put us through.

This review is about a previous incident that still makes my blood boil. We placed a cake order an entire week in advance — more than enough time for any competent bakery to prepare. But on the actual day, Theobroma simply did not make the cake at all. And the reason? They forgot. Yes, they literally forgot to make a pre-scheduled cake order.

No update, no warning, no apology — nothing. Just silence and complete negligence.

This wasn’t a small mistake — it was a complete failure, and it shows just how little they value their customers.
